content.value: The annual peak load on a 30 MW power station is 25 MW. The power station (10) supplies loads having maximum demands of 8.5 MW, 10 MW, 5 MW and 4.5 MW. The annual load factor is 45%. Find the (i) average load, (ii) energy supplied per year, (iii) diversity factor and (iv) demand factor.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
